import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        double length;
        Edge(int f, int t, double l) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            length = l;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        ArrayList<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class Graph {
        ArrayList<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();

        Graph(int nr_nodes, int nr_edges) {
            for (int i = 0; i < nr_nodes; i++) {
                nodes.add(new Node());
            }
            edges.ensureCapacity(nr_edges);
        }

        void add_edge(int from, int to, double length) {
            edges.add(new Edge(from, to, length));
            nodes.get(from).out.add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> find_augmenting_path(int source, int sink,
                double[] flow, double[] path_cap) {
            PriorityQueue<Pair> q = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b.key, a.key));
            double[] capacity = new double[nodes.size()];
            int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
            Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
            Arrays.fill(capacity, 0);

            capacity[source] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            q.add(new Pair(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, source));

            while (!q.isEmpty() && capacity[sink] == 0) {
                Pair p = q.poll();
                double cap = p.key;
                int n = p.value;

                if (cap < capacity[n]) continue;

                for (int idx : nodes.get(n).out) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                    double e_cap = e.length - flow[idx];
                    if (e_cap > 0 && Math.min(cap, e_cap) > capacity[e.to]) {
                        capacity[e.to] = Math.min(cap, e_cap);
                        q.add(new Pair(capacity[e.to], e.to));
                        pred[e.to] = idx;
                    }
                }
            }

            path_cap[0] = capacity[sink];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int e_idx = pred[sink]; e_idx != -1; e_idx = pred[edges.get(e_idx).from]) {
                path.add(e_idx);
            }
            return path;
        }

        double max_flow(int source, int sink) {
            Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size(), 2 * edges.size());
            double[] flow = new double[2 * edges.size()];

            for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                residual.add_edge(edges.get(i).from, edges.get(i).to, edges.get(i).length);
                residual.add_edge(edges.get(i).to, edges.get(i).from, 0);
            }

            double max_flow = 0;
            double[] path_cap = new double[1];
            ArrayList<Integer> path;
            while (!(path = residual.find_augmenting_path(source, sink, flow, path_cap)).isEmpty() && path_cap[0] > 0) {
                for (int e_idx : path) {
                    int e_ridx = (e_idx % 2) == 1 ? e_idx - 1 : e_idx + 1;
                    flow[e_idx] += path_cap[0];
                    flow[e_ridx] -= path_cap[0];
                }
            }

            for (int idx : residual.nodes.get(source).out) {
                max_flow += flow[idx];
            }
            return max_flow;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        double key;
        int value;
        Pair(double k, int v) {
            key = k;
            value = v;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists = 0, capsules = 0;

        Room() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int get_node_id(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void set_reactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void set_infected(int timestamp) {
            if (accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spread_infection(int timestamp) {
            if (infected[timestamp]) {
                set_infected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i > 0) floorplan[i-1][j].set_infected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i < n-1) floorplan[i+1][j].set_infected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j-1].set_infected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j < n-1) floorplan[i][j+1].set_infected(timestamp + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static Room[][] floorplan = new Room[10][10];

    static String id_to_string(int id) {
        if (id == 0) return "source";
        if (id == 1) return "sink";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int row = (id - 2) % n;
        int col = ((id - 2 - row) % (n * n)) / n;
        int timestamp = (id - 2 - row - col * n) / (n * n);
        sb.append("(").append(row).append(",").append(col).append(",").append(timestamp).append(")");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
                if (line.charAt(j) == 'Y') floorplan[i][j].set_reactor();
                else if (line.charAt(j) == 'Z') floorplan[i][j].set_infected(0);
                else floorplan[i][j].scientists = line.charAt(j) - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (line.charAt(j) != 'Y' && line.charAt(j) != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = line.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) floorplan[i][j].spread_infection(c);
                }
            }
        }

        Graph g = new Graph(n * n * (t + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) g.add_edge(0, room.get_node_id(0), room.scientists);
                if (room.capsules > 0) g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(t), 1, room.capsules);
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c), room.get_node_id(t), 1000);
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0 && floorplan[i-1][j].accessible[c])
                            g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c), floorplan[i-1][j].get_node_id(c+1), 1000);
                        if (i < n-1 && floorplan[i+1][j].accessible[c])
                            g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c), floorplan[i+1][j].get_node_id(c+1), 1000);
                        if (j > 0 && floorplan[i][j-1].accessible[c])
                            g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c), floorplan[i][j-1].get_node_id(c+1), 1000);
                        if (j < n-1 && floorplan[i][j+1].accessible[c])
                            g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c), floorplan[i][j+1].get_node_id(c+1), 1000);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) g.max_flow(0, 1));
    }
}
